FAQ

Catalog Images Questions

What quality photo do I need to upload?

A clear, well-lit phone or camera photo of your product is enough — we standardize lighting, background, and framing from there. We'll flag anything too low-resolution to work with before you're charged.

How many revisions are included?

Every catalog image includes one round of revisions as part of the price. Additional revisions can be requested at a small added cost.

Can this replace my product photography entirely?

For most ecommerce catalog needs, yes — Classic Catalog covers standard product shots at scale. If your brand has a very specific art direction, Custom Brand Catalog is built for that instead.
